fixture.id: hidden from model; audit identifier only

visibility_rules: Only the object under visible is supplied to paired predictors.
Fixture id/family/oracle are never serialized into model-visible prompt content.
surface_forms identify entities only; they may not contain hidden predicate IDs or semantic gloss annotations.
opaque predicate IDs are randomly assigned independently of semantic meaning before heldout generation and contain no mnemonic substrings.
